name: Bottle of Moonshine
summary: In Darkshire, a bottle of moonshine is sought for Lakeshire’s tavern. Barkeep Daniels needs one while Blackrock orc incursions keep regular supplies from reaching town.

sections.title: A Spirited Relief
sections.body: Blackrock orcs have cut off Lakeshire’s regular supply caravans. Barkeep Daniels seeks regional drinks to restock the tavern for the guards and townsfolk. One is brewed and sold at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire, where locals favor strong drinks.

faq.q: Where can I find a Bottle of Moonshine?
faq.answer: Find a Bottle of Moonshine at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire, within Duskwood.
Barkeep Daniels, Lakeshire’s innkeeper in the Redridge Mountains, wants the bottle and other regional drinks for his cellar during the orc siege.

faq.q: Why is Lakeshire running out of liquor?
faq.answer: Blackrock orcs have swarmed the Redridge Mountains, raiding roads and severing trade routes. Regular shipments have failed to arrive, leaving Lakeshire’s tavern shelves nearly empty.

angles.text: The trip from Darkshire to Lakeshire shows how fragile the supply lines between Stormwind’s scattered settlements are during the crisis.
